resources.string: Group or network changed; ranking was not saved. Repeat the check.
Check incomplete, timed out or worker busy. Ranking not saved; VPN unchanged. Retry after the current probe finishes.

One TCP endpoint probe where applicable and three URL requests through each temporary profile core. Ranked by passed URL requests, then median latency and URL latency spread; ties retain order. TCP alone never proves Internet access. Not a speed, YouTube, separate DNS or UDP loss test. No VPN switching. Cancel or a changed group/network prevents saving. Per-profile limit 25 seconds, whole group 5 minutes. Test traffic may not appear in the running VPN session counters.
